title: System 3: Reusable event-template automation
summary: System formula.event_templates: original narrative, linked evidence and 1 accomplishment(s).
body:
## System 3: Reusable event-template automation

Built parameterized templates connected to live event data so recurring publishing cycles could adapt to different dates, locations, results, statistics, and contextual material without being rebuilt each time.

Workflow:

- Waited for results to reach the required state.
- Pulled rankings, standings, timing, statistics, and commentary.
- Applied the relevant event and location context to a reusable brand template.
- Generated accompanying copy with AI.
- Published the result across platforms without manual handling after setup.

Output and impact:

- Replaced event-by-event recreation with a reusable data-driven workflow.
- Converted repeated operating knowledge into a parameterized template.
- Reduced dependence on a person remembering and executing each step of the publishing cycle.

Maintainability evidence:

- The workflow waits for an explicit data condition rather than relying on guesswork.
- Variable event context is passed as data instead of hard-coded into a new workflow.
- One maintained template supports repeated cycles.
